package.name: ur_kinematic_assembly_demo
package.description: Kinematic assembly demo for the UR10e (no vision, no gripper). The object is rigidly attached to the flange; its pose w.r.t. tool0 and the assembled pose are ground truth from config, and the assembly path is a CSV trajectory. The robot goes to a stand-off, then executes the trajectory under either position control (scaled_joint_trajectory_controller) or admittance control (ros2_control admittance_controller, tunable) with an optional force-guarded stop.
